author: Thomas à Kempis
title: Of the oblation of Christ upon the cross, and of resignation of self

verses.text: As I of my own will offered myself unto God the Father on the Cross for thy sins with outstretched hands and naked body, so that nothing remained in Me that did not become altogether a sacrifice for the Divine propitiation; so also oughtest thou every day to offer thyself willingly unto Me for a pure and holy oblation with all thy strength and affections, even to the utmost powers of thine heart.
verses.modernizedText: As I of My own will offered Myself to God the Father on the Cross for your sins, with outstretched hands and naked body, so that nothing remained in Me that did not become altogether a sacrifice for the Divine propitiation, so you also ought every day willingly to offer yourself to Me as a pure and holy offering, with all your strength and affections, even to the utmost powers of your heart.

verses.text: What more do I require of thee than thou study to resign thyself altogether unto Me?
verses.modernizedText: What more do I require of you than that you strive to surrender yourself altogether to Me?

verses.text: Whatsoever thou givest besides thyself, I nothing care for, for I ask not thy gift, but thee.
verses.modernizedText: Whatever you give besides yourself, I care nothing for, because I ask not for your gift, but for you.

verses.text: As it would not be sufficient for thee if thou hadst all things except Me, even so whatsoever thou shalt give Me, if thou give Me not thyself, it cannot please Me.
verses.modernizedText: As it would not be enough for you to have all things except Me, so whatever you give Me cannot please Me if you do not give Me yourself.

verses.text: Offer thyself to Me, and give thyself altogether for God, so shall thy offering be accepted.
verses.modernizedText: Offer yourself to Me and give yourself altogether for God; so your offering will be accepted.

verses.text: Behold I offered Myself altogether to the Father for thee, I give also My whole body and blood for food, that thou mightest remain altogether Mine and I thine.
verses.modernizedText: See, I offered Myself altogether to the Father for you; I also give My whole body and blood for food, so that you may remain altogether Mine and I yours.

verses.text: But if thou stand in thyself, and offer not thyself freely to My will, thy offering is not perfect, neither shall the union betwixt us be complete.
verses.modernizedText: But if you stand in yourself and do not freely offer yourself to My will, your offering is not perfect, nor will the union between us be complete.

verses.text: Therefore ought the freewill offering of thyself into the hands of God to go before all thy works, if thou wilt attain liberty and grace.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore the freewill offering of yourself into God’s hands ought to go before all your works, if you would attain liberty and grace.

verses.text: For this is the cause that so few are inwardly enlightened and made free, that they know not how to deny themselves entirely.
verses.modernizedText: For this is the reason so few are inwardly enlightened and made free: they do not know how to deny themselves entirely.

verses.text: My word standeth sure, Except a man forsake all, he cannot be My disciple.(1) Thou therefore, if thou wilt be My disciple, offer thyself to Me with all thy affections.
verses.modernizedText: My word stands sure: Unless a person forsakes all, he cannot be My disciple.(1) Therefore, if you would be My disciple, offer yourself to Me with all your affections.
